filters.description: Structured JSON object for pre-filtering by language, kind, visibility, or minimum score. Pass a JSON object; for string-style predicates, use the `query` parameter instead.

language.description: Limit results to specific programming languages. Example: ["rust", "typescript", "python"]

score_min.description: Minimum semantic relevance score (0.0 – 1.0). Results below this threshold are excluded.

symbol_kind.description: Filter by symbol kinds such as "function", "method", "class", "struct", "trait", "interface", "enum", etc. Example: ["function", "method"]

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned from previous page

query.description: Semantic query expression (supports predicates like `lang:rust`, `kind:function`, combinators `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`, and regex `name~=/pat/`).
